answer: Practically, the chain should cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because mirror only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, raven is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any dune approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
